style.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a realistic studio-style product illustration for a precision mold component catalog.

execution.reason: Single-image catalog draft runner is available; legacy punch batch CLI must not be used for this plan.
execution.subsequentReviewBatchSize: 2–3 images requested sequentially; stop for review between batches
execution.modelAndPrice: Confirm provider model availability and current price before generating. A non-empty local token is not proof of API validity.
execution.costNote: 36 accepted product images is a content target, not a cap on billed attempts. 8 composites use approved assets without new image generation. Revisions require a separately chosen retry.

publishing.mobile: Use object-contain, full silhouettes and generous safe margins. Check the actual two-column mobile catalog plus full-width detail page; reflow the hero, do not crop tips.
acceptance: Straight axes, plausible shoulders, open bores and distinct parts
Consistent background, light direction, contrast and framing
No fabricated grade, stock or dimensional claim
